ai_business_automation.summary: A new study says most organisations use AI in hiring, yet barely one in ten can show measurable improvement; hybrid human-plus-AI workflows outperform either alone. Automation angle: the gap between 'adopted AI' and 'measured ROI' is exactly where automation consultants earn fees.

ai_business_automation.summary: Nandan Nilekani argues automation and AI make large companies net job losers, while millions of AI-equipped small businesses become the employment engine. Automation angle: SMB-focused automation services are the volume market this thesis predicts.

quantum_ai_research.title: OpenAI 'Astra': the quantum math-solving model, explained
quantum_ai_research.summary: Mashable rounds up what is known about Astra, the next-generation OpenAI model credited with cracking open problems in quantum complexity theory. It is the clearest sign yet that frontier models are being aimed directly at quantum-computing research questions. Automation angle: research-agent products that grind on quantum problems are becoming a real category — watch for API access.

quantum_ai_research.title: Multiverse: quantum-inspired compression runs AI models 93% faster on Qualcomm chips
quantum_ai_research.summary: Multiverse Computing says its quantum-inspired tensor-network compression makes LLMs run up to 93% faster on Qualcomm hardware. Quantum mathematics — not quantum hardware — is already accelerating edge AI today. Automation angle: compressed on-device models slash inference costs for automation products; track CompactifAI-class tooling.

quantum_ai_research.title: Gartner: enterprise AI workloads will NOT run on quantum hardware through 2028
quantum_ai_research.summary: Gartner predicts enterprise-scale AI workloads will stay off quantum hardware through at least 2028, tempering quantum-AI hype. The near-term value is quantum-inspired algorithms on classical chips. Automation angle: sell what works now — quantum-inspired optimization, not quantum hardware promises.

quantum_ai_research.title: AI finds fatal flaw in a post-quantum encryption candidate
quantum_ai_research.summary: An AI system uncovered a fatal weakness in a candidate post-quantum encryption scheme, showing ML tooling now stress-tests the cryptography meant to survive quantum computers. Automation angle: AI-driven crypto auditing is an emerging security niche with almost no incumbents.

quantum_ai_research.title: India's first Quantum + AI university opens in Amaravati in September
quantum_ai_research.summary: India's first dedicated quantum and AI university will start functioning from a temporary campus in Amaravati this September. quantum_ai_research.title: Six academicians chart a blueprint for quantum-plus-AI 'smart computing'
quantum_ai_research.summary: A group of senior Chinese academicians published a joint blueprint for combining quantum computing and AI into a unified smart-computing agenda. quantum_ai_research.summary: Israel launched a national push spanning a quantum-computer tender and physical-AI leadership, tying both into one sovereignty strategy. Automation angle: national quantum+AI programs mean funded pilot projects — watch the tenders.

unaddressed_ai_problems.title: Humans in the loop miss a third of dangerous AI coding-agent requests

'Human in the loop' is failing as a safety mechanism and nobody has a working replacement. Affects every team running coding agents. Automation angle: build guardrail tooling — automated command-risk scoring is an unsolved, monetizable gap.

unaddressed_ai_problems.title: AI failed to properly patch software flaws 74% of the time

unaddressed_ai_problems.title: Why normal people aren't using AI agents

general_news.title: Trump imposes 15% tariff on key chip material to counter China
general_news.summary: The US imposed a 15% tariff on a key semiconductor material, aiming to shield American firms from intensifying Chinese chip competition.

general_news.title: Meta fined $567M in largest child-safety ruling against a social media giant
general_news.summary: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $567M for harms to children, the largest child-safety penalty yet against a social platform.

general_news.title: EasyJet agrees £5.7bn takeover by US firm Apollo
general_news.summary: EasyJet accepted a £5.7bn acquisition by Apollo after a rival suitor withdrew, moving one of Europe's biggest budget carriers into US ownership.

general_news.title: How Ukraine is taking the war deeper into Russia
general_news.summary: Ukrainian strikes are systematically targeting economic and military supply chains far inside Russian territory, including oil refineries.

general_news.title: Houthi attacks reportedly kill at least 30 Yemeni government forces
general_news.summary: Houthi missile and drone attacks on positions in Marib and Hadramawt reportedly killed at least 30 Yemeni government troops, escalating the regional conflict.

general_news.title: US Senate committee votes to hold Fauci in contempt over Covid hearing
general_news.summary: A Senate committee voted to hold Anthony Fauci in contempt for refusing to answer questions about his handling of the pandemic, referring him for possible prosecution.

general_news.title: South Korea shares Moon images after SpaceX rocket debris crash
general_news.summary: Seoul's lunar orbiter captured before-and-after images of the Moon's surface where SpaceX rocket debris struck it this week.

general_news.title: Australian crew completes daring midwinter Antarctica medical rescue
general_news.summary: An Australian aviation team evacuated a patient from McMurdo Station after landing in total darkness at -43°C — one of the most difficult rescues attempted on the continent.
